title: Days between dates
task: Implement days_between(start, end) in dates.py: both are ISO dates such as '2024-03-01'; return the number of days from start to end, negative when end is before start. Raise ValueError for a malformed date. Add tests.
follow_up: Requirement change: add a keyword argument business_only=False. When it is true, count only the Monday-to-Friday days in the half-open range [start, end); when end is before start, count [end, start) and make it negative. The default behaviour does not change. Add tests.
